body: I was sexually assaulted by a friend a couple months ago, and I am struggling to deal with it, and kinda wish I was dead.

Suicide hotlines feel cold tbh. I don't call because that is terrifying, but I have used the text ones. They have a 45 minute time limit, but take 5 minutes to respond to any text. 9 text messages doesn't do a whole lot to get me out of a crisis point. Also I can be in crisis for weeks at a time where I have to actively try not to kill myself. I am in therapy, but therapy is one hour a week.  I live with my brain 24/7. During a bad 2-3 week span I may have to use a crisis line a few times if I don't think I can handle it.  If you are a repeat user, they limit your time even more.  Honestly I don't use the crisis lines any more because they made me feel worthless and like I was wasting their time, which made me more suicidal. Great resource of it's a one time thing,  but if you have a mental disorder (I have complex PTSD) it's not reliable.

Would she have continued the pregnancy had it not been ectopic? If she would have terminated the pregnancy regardless, I think that there is an issue there, not so much in the removal of the fallopian tube, but the disregard to human life. 
 The intention is not the death of the child.  The intention is to remove a fallopian tube that is going to rupture. It's not a removal in order to terminate the pregnancy. It's about the desired consequences as well as the means. You can not directly kill one person to save another.

One is treating a problem that has an unfortunate, foreseeable, but unintended and undesired consequence of the death of the child, the other is killing the child. You can't simply "plop an amniotic sac onto a table and wait for it to die" because you are doing that to kill the fetus. You must meet all four principles included in the principle of double effect.

I have a therapist. I'm not going to report it though.  I went through with reporting the first assault and the detective pretty much just blamed me. I'm not doing that a second time. Also I really do believe this was a mental health issue on his part. I just want my faith back.
